items.title: Players report a first-person mode glitch; Rockstar has not commented
TmarTn2's video of stealing a fighter jet from a military base passes 5 million views in under a day
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at midnight local time (US storefronts unlock on Eastern time)
Metacritic score of 99 with no mixed or negative critic reviews; user reviews open later
Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6 million copies and about $2.36 billion including preorders (third-party estimate, not confirmed by Take-Two)
Launch streams peak at about 7.91 million concurrent viewers
PSN sign-in trouble in the first hours; PlayStation status page clear since
Players report a 602 MB update clears PS5 error CE-108255-1; no official Rockstar patch notes yet
Xbox Cloud Gaming streaming is live (runs on Series S settings)
Warning: 'GTA 6 PC download' and 'cracked' builds are fake; some carry malware. There is no PC version.
Rockstar moves the release to November 19, 2026 (after earlier targets of Fall 2025 and May 26, 2026)
